note: Measured 2026-09-28 in real Chrome (browser_exec) on a real OffscreenCanvas with genuinely rendered text. NOT a simulation: bench/make_l3_harness.py inlines the actual runL3Text source extracted from models.ts and the page draws the detected regions over the text so the boxes can be seen.

previous_state.note: 4 of 16 pixel-channel PII values were recovered before this. The channel is labelled `pixels`, not `canvas`; an earlier harness filtered on 'canvas', matched nothing, and reported 0/0 — a number that reads like a pass.

honest_limits: This is the DETECTOR only. End-to-end canvas safety additionally rests on the OPAQUE_REGION fail-closed rule, which redacts the whole element until L3 clears it — so a miss here is not by itself a leak.
The detector is a geometric edge-density heuristic, not a learned text detector. No browser-loadable text detector (DBNet/EAST/CRAFT) exists on the Hub; see MODEL_FINDINGS in models.ts.
Scored on 4 canvases with one text line each. Coverage on dense multi-region canvases is not established.
